gloss: to stay still; to remain motionless; to stare fixedly

definitions.gloss: to stay still; to remain motionless; to keep quiet
definitions.explanation: To hold one's body still without moving, often requiring patience or self-control.
To look at something or someone steadily and intently without looking away.

{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧じっとして⟦いろ→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ。

notes:
An onomatopoeic suru-verb where ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧ expresses the idea of being fixed in place or focused without movement. In sense 1, it describes physical stillness — holding one's body motionless. In sense 2, it describes visual fixation — staring without looking away. Both senses share the core idea of sustained, unbroken focus or immobility.

⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧ can also function as an adverb without ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait patiently without moving), ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ (to endure without flinching).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- じっとして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be staying still
- ⟦じっと{見|み}る→じっと見る：26091_jittomiru⟧: to stare at
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧: to gaze at intently
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait patiently
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{我慢|がまん}する→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧: to endure without moving
- じっとして⟦いられない→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be unable to stay still

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{動|うご}かない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to not move — neutral description of absence of movement, without the nuance of effort or intent
- ⟦{黙|だま}っている→黙る：02287_damaru⟧: to be silent — focuses on not speaking rather than not moving
- ⟦{凝視|ぎょうし}する→凝視する：25402_gyoushisuru⟧: to stare; to gaze — formal/literary equivalent of the staring sense
